ModMetaData.name: Mirror Build
ModMetaData.author: pineappleLemonade67
ModMetaData.description:
From-the-Depths-style mirror building: place on one side, get the other side free.
While a build, reinstall, or plan designator is selected: - M: cycle mirror mode (off -> vertical -> horizontal -> 4-way) - N: lock/unlock the mirror axis (unlocked, it follows the mouse)
Mirrored placements keep stuff and get mirrored rotation. Both keys are rebindable under Architect controls.
Mod settings: axis line color, toggleable axis numbers with adjustable gap (counted outward from the axis), and opt-in mirroring of planning designations.
